CustomField.description: Rich text stored for the template header region. Use the dedicated header Form component (FormQualifiedApiName (Header)) for the rendered runtime header; this field holds simple HTML header content where a full Form component is not configured.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Add formatted header content (title, intro copy, branding) to show at the top of the form. For richer headers, configure a header Form component instead.
CustomField.label: Template Header Text
